n = int(input())
s = input()

max_underscore_seq = 0
word_count = 0
last_index = -1
i = 0
inside_parentheses = False
length = len(s)

while i < length:
    c = s[i]
    if c == '_' and not inside_parentheses and max_underscore_seq < i - last_index - 1:
        max_underscore_seq = i - last_index - 1
    if c == '_' and inside_parentheses and i - last_index > 1:
        word_count += 1
    if c == '(':
        inside_parentheses = True
        if max_underscore_seq < i - last_index - 1:
            max_underscore_seq = i - last_index - 1
    if c == ')':
        inside_parentheses = False
        if i - last_index > 1:
            word_count += 1
    if c in ['_', '(', ')']:
        last_index = i
    i += 1

if max_underscore_seq < length - last_index - 1:
    max_underscore_seq = length - last_index - 1

print(str(max_underscore_seq) + " " + str(word_count))
